pricing_negotiation: Option A - 12mo reserved: 500 GPU-hours/month, 20% burst at pro-rated rate, overage = 1.5x unit rate, annual billing suggestion; target ARR ~ $225k.

Option B - 9mo ramp: months 1-3 bill at 50% of reserved, months 4-9 at full reserved, burst 15% for first 3 months, overage higher (1.7x) but with cap; finance prefers to reduce immediate cash impact.
Requested commercial term: SLA-backed latency target (p95 <200ms for chat) + credit structure if missed; security addendum and DPA to be attached to SOW.
requirements_summary: Product team needs predictable, low-latency inference for in-app chat and enterprise search. Target: median <100ms, p95 <200ms, throughput 20-40 req/s. Model preference: quantized Llama-family 13B; want automated fallback to smaller model under high load. Cost sensitivity: moderate — willing to commit in exchange for predictable per-token/GPU economics. Must support VPC peering, SSO/SAML, KMS-managed keys, audit logs shipped to Splunk, and US data residency.
